test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the marks obtained by two students X and Y in 6 subjects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/731a718ae6f4e774bedcd598aa1f301d8f0894194e9653a860c3b3d9c45251b9.png] 

What is the ratio of total marks obtained by X in all the subjects to the total marks obtained by Y in all the subjects?
solution:
**Calculation:**

 The total marks obtained by X = 120 + 160 + 240 + 200 + 40 + 220 = 980

 The total marks obtained by Y = 60 + 280 + 260 + 140 + 180 + 80 = 1000

The ratio is:

980 : 1000

98 : 100

49 : 50

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
